metadata.title: 90s R&B Group Portrait with Bold Outlined Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A three-person group portrait featuring urban streetwear and a massive, high-contrast outlined display font layered over the subjects.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of three young men in dark urban clothing and sunglasses, posed against a bright white background, dominated by a large, lowercase, sans-serif wordmark with a thick white outline.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography acts as a foreground barrier partially obscuring the subjects
High contrast between dark clothing and bright white background
Repetitive use of dark eyewear across all subjects
coreInvariants: Thick white outline on black lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, filling the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large 'm' characters in the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central figure's face down to the bold text, then outward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright white space at the top and bottom edges, creating a stark cutout effect for the dark-clad subjects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white with low saturation in the environment.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic base with natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Heavy white outer stroke that creates a halo effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' dot is a square block
Vertical terminals are flat and squared off
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Strong vertical presence and tight counters

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast studio portrait of three young men in black streetwear and sunglasses against a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large lowercase word in a black condensed sans-serif font with a very thick white outline, positioned across the center-bottom of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is there a thick white outline around the black letters?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Brand logos on clothing or jewelry
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is lowercase
Ensure the white outline is thick and visible against the dark clothes
Verify the background is blown-out white
Confirm all subjects are wearing dark eyewear
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast group portrait in dark clothing against white, then overlay a massive, black, lowercase, condensed sans-serif title with a heavy white stroke.
